questions.question: Find the value of ‘a’ for which x + sqrt {3x} + frac{{{a²}}}{4} is a perfect square.
questions.solution:
Any quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 is a perfect square if the discriminate (D) is zero, where D = b² - 4ac

Given equation, x + √(3x) + a²/4 = 0

Putting x = y², we get,

⇒ y² + y√3 + a²/4 = 0

In order to be a perfect square,

⇒ D = (√3)² - (4 × 1 × a²/4) = 0

⇒ 3 - a² = 0

⇒ a² = 3

∴ a = √

questions.question:
In triangle ABC, Ois the orthocentre and angle BOC is 120°. Calculate angle BAC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a55a192db2bfc48be0768486bad9f04aa49094bd841a394ed437b17a0eb23e94.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠BOC = 120° 

**Concept used:**

For any triangle, the angle made by any side with the orthocentre of the triangle and the opposite vertex angle are supplementary angles

**Calculation:**

⇒ ∠BAC + ∠BOC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC + 120° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° - 120°

∴ **∠BAC = 60°**

questions.question: A man sells two articles. The cost price of the first article is equal to the selling price of the second article. The first article is sold at a profit of 20% and the second articles is sold at a loss of 20%. What is the ratio of the selling price of the first article and the cost price of the second article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let the cost price of the first article be Rs. ‘x’

But, the first article is sold at a profit of 20%,

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling price of first article = x + 20% of x = x + x/5 = (6/5)x

Now,

Selling price of second article = Cost price of first article = Rs. x

But, the second article is sold at a loss of 20%,

⇒ (100 - 20)% of Cost price of second article = Selling price

⇒ 80% of Cost price of second article = Selling price

⇒ (4/5) × Cost price of second article = x

⇒ Cost price of second article = (5/4)x

∴** Required ratio = (6x/5) ∶ (5x/4) = 24 ∶ 25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**CP of first article = SP of second article = x

Selling price of first article = x × (120/100) = 6x/5

Cost price of second article = x × (125/100) = 5x/4

⇒ (6x/5) ∶ (5x/4) = 24 ∶ 25

Sumit is 28% less efficient than Amit. If Amit can make a wall in 54 days, then Sumit can complete the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Sumit is 28% less efficient than Amit.

Amit can make a wall in 54 days,

**CALCULATION:**

Amit’s 1 day work = 1/54

∵ Sumit is 28% less efficient than Amit,

⇒ Sumit’s 1 day work = (100 - 28)% of (Amit’s 1 day work)

⇒ Sumit’s 1 day work = 72% of (1/54)

⇒ Sumit’s 1 day work = 18/25 × 1/54

⇒ Sumit’s 1 day work = 1/75

∴ Sumit can complete the same work in 75 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the efficiency of Amit be 100. 

The efficiency of Sumit be 100 - 28 = 72.

The ratio of efficiency = 72 ∶ 100 = 18 ∶ 25

The total work = 54 × 25 = 1350

The time required = 1350/18 = 75 days

**∴ The required time is 75 days.**

questions.question: A train left 1 hour later than the scheduled time but in order to reach its destination 200 km away in time, it had to increase its usual speed by 10 km/hr. What is the usual speed (in km/hr) of the train?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the usual speed of the train be ‘x’ km/hr.

Time taken to cover 200 km = Distance/Speed = 200/x hrs.

But, when the train left 1 hour left,

Speed of train = (x + 10) km/hr.

⇒ Time taken = Distance/Speed = 200/(x + 10)

⇒ (200/x) - 1 = 200/(x + 10)

⇒ (200 - x)/x = 200/(x + 10)

⇒ (200 - x)(x + 10) = 200x

⇒ 200x + 2000 - x² - 10x = 200x

⇒ x² + 10x - 2000 = 0

⇒ x² + 50x - 40x - 2000 = 0

⇒ x(x + 50) - 40(x + 50) = 0

⇒ (x - 40)(x + 50) = 0

⇒ x = 40, - 50

∵ Speed cannot be negative,

∴ **Usual speed of train = 40 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the usual speed of the train be x km/hr.

Distance = (X × Y)/(X - Y) [time difference]

⇒ 200 = [x × (x + 10)/10] × 1

⇒ 2000 = x(x + 10)

⇒ 40 × 50 = x × (x + 10)

⇒ 40 × (40 + 10) = x × (x + 10)

x = 40 km/hr

**∴ Usual speed of train = 40 km/hr.**

questions.question: The length of the diagonal of a square is 12 cm. Find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of diagonal = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Diagonal of square = √2 × a 

Area of square = a²

**Calculation:**

Diagonal of a square = √2 × a 

⇒ 12 = side × √2

⇒ Side of square = 12/√2 = 6√2 cm

⇒ Area of square = (side)² = (6√2)²

**∴ The area of square is 72 cm²**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Area of square = (Diagonal)²/2

⇒ (12)²/2 = 144/2

⇒ 72

∴ The area of square is 72 cm2

questions.question: If the measure of the exterior angle of a regular polygon is 72° then how many sides does it have?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Exterior angle = 72° 

**Calculation:**

For a regular polygon with n sides,

Measure of exterior angle = 360°/n

⇒ 72° = 360°/n

∴ No. of sides of polygon = 360°/72° = 5

questions.question: Find the curved surface area (in cm²) of a right circular cylinder of diameter 7 cm and height 6 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter = 7 cm 

Height = 6 cm

**Calculation:**

For a right circular cylinder with radius ‘r’ and height ‘h’,

Curved surface area = 2πrh

Radius of cylinder = 7/2 = 3.5 cm

Height = 6 cm

∴ Curved surface area of given cylinder = 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 6 = **132 cm²**
